sents.d: Questionnaires and shot lists that avoid day-of surprises.
Most photography disasters are preventable with better onboarding, not better gear.
Send new clients a short questionnaire before the shoot covering expectations, must-have shots, and any specific people or moments they care about.

scenes.heading: Backup plans and a shot list

sents.d: For outdoor or event shoots, agree on a weather backup plan and a rough shot list in advance, and confirm timing and location details again 24–48 hours before the shoot.
A signed contract covering deposit, usage rights, and rescheduling terms should happen before any of this planning begins.

take: Sign the contract, plan the backup, confirm details 24–48 hours out.
